integrity: Original source dates and source contributions are separated; planar-walk inverse-moment theory and classical ridge regularization are credited as prior tools. No claim of independent validation or certified historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: One-step RGRK-SA statement for a two-dimensional consistent SPD system under a specified positive angular noise law, for every fixed finite N >=2; ridge remedy is one-step and is not an entire-trajectory theorem. The infinite mean-square proof uses analytic small-ball lower bounds, not simulation.
title: Normalized noisy rows can cause infinite mean-square error after signal averaging
